scope_caveat: Evaluated on 11 hand-written queries against 5 knowledge-base documents. Small evaluation set for a small, purpose-built corpus. Demonstrates the retrieval mechanism works, including on paraphrased queries that don't reuse the source document's exact wording. NOT a claim about retrieval accuracy on a large, heterogeneous real regulatory corpus, where TF-IDF's lack of true semantic understanding (e.g. synonyms, paraphrase at scale) would be a much bigger limitation -- see the sentence-transformers upgrade path in knowledge_base.py for that case.
